summary: Iter 78 — Doc Studio (new Launchpad card). Backend: 22/22 pytest tests passed (status, analyze manual+AI, template gen for sdd/plan/srs, invalid kind 400, docs persistence, structure update, manual doc edit, PDF (>10KB, %PDF header), save-to-documents into folder 'Doc Studio', per-user isolation (404 for others), jobs listing owner-scoped, extract-text .txt, RBAC intern+member can analyze/generate, delete flow). Frontend E2E via Playwright: Launchpad card visible for admin → /app/doc-studio → 3D hero + describe form → manual analyze (POST 200) → structure editable (name/type/domain/weeks/problem + chips) → save → tab plan → generate-template shows preview with Milestones table → edit/save markdown → PDF download works → save-to-documents 200 → SDD & SRS template generation both render preview → History (5) → all data-testids resolve. Refine controls present for SDD (input+send). Toast 'Generated from template' visible.
critical_code_review_comments: doc_studio.py is 484 lines — acceptable, well-scoped single module. No refactor needed.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded in all reads (projection {'_id': 0}) — good.

analyze() falls back to heuristic silently on AI exception. Good UX, but consider a subtle flag/log so admins can spot AI budget exhaustion — currently the client only sees analysis_mode='manual' when it asked for 'ai'.
PDF endpoint synchronously renders WeasyPrint on the request thread — fine for moderate use, but may block event loop on large docs. Consider run_in_executor if hot.
extract-text validates size (10MB cap) but not content-type. Minor — tolerated.
No rate limit on /doc-studio/analyze (AI) — potential cost risk. Consider throttle per-user per-minute.

If AI budget is exhausted later, /generate?mode=ai will return 502 and /refine will return 502 — this is expected, template & manual editing remain functional. Note: page.fill() on controlled textareas may not sync React state — use element.click() + press_sequentially() for the ds-description textarea in future scripts.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The only script hiccup: page.fill on the controlled <textarea data-testid='ds-description'> did not always update React state before the click on ds-analyze-manual — switching to click+press_sequentially resolved it. Not a product bug.
